p: Zhejiang Sanlong New Material Technology Co., Ltd. is located at No. 2345 Binhai 11th Road, Wenzhou Economic and Technological Development Zone, Zhejiang Province. The former Wenzhou Sanlong Fluoroplastic Products Factory was founded in 2000. To meet the company's development needs, it acquired Wenzhou Tianhui Electric Appliance Co., Ltd. in 2017. The PTFE production department specializes in the manufacture, processing, and sale of PTFE (polytetrafluoroethylene), PTFE gaskets, and various modified PTFE products. The company operates a quality management system and serves the industry with integrity, technical strength, and product quality. Zhejiang Sanlong New Material Technology Co., Ltd. welcomes visitors from all sectors for tours, technical guidance, and business discussions.
pc: 浙江三龙新材料科技有限公司位于浙江省温州市经济技术开发区滨海十一路2345号。原温州市三龙氟塑制品厂成立于2000年。因企业发展需要，于2017年收购温州天惠电器有限公司。聚四氟乙烯生产部专业从事聚四氟乙烯(PTFE)、四氟垫及各种改性四氟的生产加工及销售，公司建有质量管理体系，以诚信、实力和产品质量服务业界。浙江三龙新材料科技有限公司欢迎各界朋友莅临参观、指导和业务洽谈。
